_about: Fallback 10-year government bond yields, used as the Max Sharpe risk-free rate ONLY when the live CNBC fetch fails (PROJECT_SPEC.md Section 3.4). The app always says on screen when one of these is used, with its as-of date. To update: replace yield_percent and as_of for a market with a current value (e.g. from https://www.cnbc.com/quotes/US10Y, /IN10Y, /AU10Y-AU) and record the update in CLAUDE.md. A fallback older than 90 days is shown with an extra 'may be out of date' warning.

Australia (ASX).source: CNBC, Australia 10 Year Bond (AU10Y-AU), recorded manually

USA.source: CNBC, U.S. 10 Year Treasury (US10Y), recorded manually
